items.title: 5 day forecast updated as of 5 October 2026 12:44am
items.description:
##Today##

Largely cloudy and mainly dry for much of the day, then a few outbreaks of rain through the evening and overnight into Tuesday.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 11°C and max. air temperature 17°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

1-3


##Wind Speed##

17


##Wind Direction##

SW


##Wind##

S or SW 15-20, occasionally 25 in the north, decreasing 10-15 in the evening, veering N or NW 5-15 later.


##Visibility##

Mostly good, then falling moderate in rain later. Occasional hill fog.


##Comments##

Occasional strong winds in the north until later.


##Tomorrow##

Occasional outbreaks of rain gradually clearing later in the day. Isolated showers later.


##Temperature##
